checkedAlternates.risk: Parsec is defined using 1 AU and 1 arcsecond of parallax.
checkedAlternates.resolution: The Astronomical Unit itself is defined as an exact SI meter constant (149,597,870,700 m, group-1), distinct from parallax-based parsecs (group-4).

checkedAlternates.risk: Light-year and parsec are both used for interstellar distances.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Light-year is defined by light travel in one Julian year (group-2), not stellar parallax (group-4).
